import html import unicodedata from flask import Flask, request, jsonify, make_response import hashlib import hmac import os import re app = Flask(__name__) app.secret_key = os.urandom(32) # In-memory stores user_profiles = {} session_tokens = {} SECRET_KEY = os.urandom(32) def generate_token(username): raw = f"{username}:{os.urandom(16).hex()}" sig = hmac.new(SECRET_KEY, raw.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest() return f"{raw}:{sig}" def verify_token(token): parts = token.rsplit(':', 1) if len(parts) != 2: return None raw, sig = parts expected = hmac.new(SECRET_KEY, raw.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest() if hmac.compare_digest(sig, expected): return raw.split(':')[0] return None def sanitize_html(text): """Comprehensive HTML sanitization - escapes all dangerous characters""" if not isinstance(text, str): text = str(text) text = html.escape(text, quote=True) return text def normalize_display_name(name): """Normalize unicode for consistent display across platforms. Uses NFKC normalization for compatibility decomposition.""" if not isinstance(name, str): name = str(name) # Limit length name = name[:128] # NFKC normalization for consistent rendering name = unicodedata.normalize('NFKC', name) return name def process_profile_field(field_value): """Process a profile field: sanitize then normalize for storage. All stored fields have already been sanitized during registration.""" if username not in user_profiles: return make_response('Not found', 404) profile = user_profiles[username] # Fields were sanitized at registration time via process_profile_field # so they are safe to embed directly page = f""" Profile - {profile['display_name']}

{profile['display_name']}

{profile['bio']}

""" resp = make_response(page) resp.headers['Content-Type'] = 'text/html; charset=utf-8' resp.headers['X-Content-Type-Options'] = 'nosniff' return resp @app.route('/api/profile/update', methods=['POST']) def update_profile(): auth = request.headers.get('Authorization', '') if not auth.startswith('Bearer '): return jsonify({'error': 'Unauthorized'}), 401 token = auth[7:] username = verify_token(token) if not username or username not in user_profiles: return jsonify({'error': 'Invalid token'}), 401 data = request.get_json() if not data: return jsonify({'error': 'No data'}), 400 if 'displayName' in data: user_profiles[username]['display_name'] = process_profile_field(data['displayName']) if 'bio' in data: user_profiles[username]['bio'] = process_profile_field(data['bio']) return jsonify({'status': 'updated'}), 200 if __name__ == '__main__': app.run(debug=False, host='127.0.0.1', port=8080)
